title: GC Conformance Report
description: Machine-readable conformance report produced by any Governance Commons validator. Version 1.0.0 of the GC conformance report format (GC-2-C-01).

gc_report_version.description: Version of the GC conformance report format schema. Must be '1.0.0' for this schema version.

spec.description: Identifier of the spec being validated against (e.g. 'ons', 'agent-dossier', 'agent-matrix').

spec_version.description: Semver of the spec targeted by this validation run (e.g. '1.4.0').

profile.description: Conformance profile evaluated. Advisory: informational only. Standard: full normative compliance. Strict: maximum enforcement including optional rules.

subject.description: Identifier of what was validated — a file path, URI, or inline label.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when this report was produced (e.g. '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z').

rules.description: Per-rule evaluation results in the order they were evaluated.

conformant.description: True if all rules for the declared profile passed. False if any required rule failed.

conformance_level.description: Highest conformance level achieved. Matches 'profile' when conformant=true; 'none' when conformant=false.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier (e.g. 'ONS-CASING-001'). Must not change across spec versions unless the rule itself changes semantics.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the rule checks.

result.description: Evaluation outcome. 'skip' means the rule was not applicable given the subject or profile.

message.description: Detail message. Required for 'fail' results. Optional context for 'skip'. Null or omitted for 'pass'.

ReportSummary.description: Aggregate counts across all rule results.

total.description: Total number of rules evaluated (passed + failed + skipped).
